title: Expectation of a difference
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of their pointwise difference is the difference of their expectations: $\mathbb{E}_p[f-g]=\mathbb{E}_p[f]-\mathbb{E}_p[g]$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued functions $f$ and $g$ on the sample space
